pro_tips: Submit the building, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical permits together in the same portal session so plan review can coordinate the ADU scope instead of bouncing the application between departments
Bring a simple code sheet with bedroom egress dimensions, smoke/CO alarm locations, and fire-separation notes — that speeds up ADU review in Salt Lake City
Because Salt Lake City adds a 1% state surcharge to permit fees, budget that into your permit total before you submit
If the basement ADU adds a bedroom, verify the egress window opening early; window well corrections are one of the most common expensive rework items

response_body.zoning_hoa_flag: ADU conversions can be affected by zoning rules, parking requirements, lot coverage, and owner-occupancy rules in Salt Lake City. If the property is in a historic district or has HOA restrictions, exterior changes such as egress windows, window wells, or new entrances may need additional approval before permit issuance.
